title: Override Allowances Card — Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit
content:
The override allowances of the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit set, for each network, how many vacation-supply, lost or stolen, and emergency-supply overrides a member may receive, how long and how early a vacation supply may be, how a lost or stolen controlled substance is treated, and whether a dose change permits an early refill.

| | Northbridge Performance Network | Northbridge Essential Network | Northbridge National Network | Northbridge Preferred Savings Network | Northbridge Retail90 Network | Northbridge Open Choice Network |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Vacation-supply overrides per drug per plan year | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Maximum days supply of a vacation override | 30 | 30 | 30 | 60 | 90 | 90 |
| Earliest grant, calendar days before the departure date | 7 | 7 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 |
| Lost, stolen or damaged overrides per drug per plan year | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Lost or stolen controlled substance may be replaced | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Police report number required for a lost or stolen controlled substance | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Early refill allowed for a dose increase with the new prescription on file | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Days supply of an emergency override while a coverage review is pending | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 5 | 5 |
| Emergency supply overrides per drug per plan year | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 |

## Card notes

- The emergency figure of 3 or 5 days is the network's emergency supply days for a drug whose coverage review is pending.
- On the Northbridge Performance Network and the Northbridge Essential Network a lost or stolen controlled substance is not replaced by override; the police report requirement is set on every network.
- The vacation lead time counts calendar days before the departure date: 7 days on the first two networks and 14 days on the other four.
